Jconradson@caringtransitions.com

Please make sure your address is updated in CTBIDS BEFORE placing a bid. Items will be shipped to the address that appears on your invoice for that auction. If you have not updated your address, Caring Transitions is not liable for items sent to the wrong address.

description:
You are purchasing a "Set of 4 VTG Glass Insulators Hemingray #16 Blue Green + #16 Green" in "Used" condition.
Set of 4 VTG Glass Insulators Hemingray #16 Blue Green + #16 Green. Some if these have cracks and chips. Colors are not all the same. Several different types and designs are slightly different. See photos for reference.
Bring classic utility charm into your collection or decor with this set of four vintage glass insulators. These iconic pieces feature beautiful blue-green tones and embossed lettering, giving them a distinctly industrial, early-20th-century look. They make great display pieces on a shelf or windowsill, or can be repurposed in creative projects like lamps, garden accents, or rustic centerpieces. Each insulator has its own character from years of use, with one showing a more pronounced crack and chipping at the base, adding to the authentic, weathered appeal. This listing includes four glass insulators in varying shapes and shades of aqua/teal, all with embossed text and ridged bases or tops for that unmistakable vintage style. Keywords: glass insulators, vintage insulators, blue green glass, industrial decor, rustic farmhouse decor, Hemingray style insulators, repurpose craft supply, antique electrical hardware, glass collection
Condition Notes:
Set of four vintage glass insulators with visible wear, surface dirt, and scuffing throughout. One insulator shows a noticeable crack and chipping near the bottom edge. Edges and rims display small nicks and roughness consistent with age and use. Glass surfaces show scratches and cloudiness in areas.

{"content": {"body": "
If you do not have a local address, we will assume you require shipping. Only email us about shipping if you are a local/in-state address that requires your items to be shipped, or if you need to schedule a pickup time. You can expect a shipping invoice to your CTBIDS account within a few days to 2 weeks after the scheduled pickup day. Once the invoice is accepted/approved, we will run the payment on our end and ship your item within 1-5 days.
**Please note:
Shipping is expensive. We do not mark up shipping. We do charge a handling fee for our time (packing, transporting, administration) and packing materials. We combine multiple lots using the most efficient and cost-effective manner of shipping. Insurance will be added for any lots in excess of $100.00. Refer to USPS.com for coverage charges.
PLEASE NOTE: Shipping may be more expensive during holidays and may also take longer to process
You will be required to select an Item Receipt Method as part of your bid. Please note which items are available for shipping.
Local pickup is preferred. Shipping is available for some items at the buyer's expense. NOT ALL LOTS CAN BE SHIPPED. We cannot ship furniture. Shippable items will be packed by Caring Transitions and shipped via USPS or UPS. If the item is fragile, we may use a 3rd party shipping provider for packing and shipping.
After your sale invoice is paid (which may include Handling fee), you will receive a separate invoice for shipping charges. Depending on the size of the sale and amount of shipping, it may be several days after pickup before you receive your shipping invoice. Once you approve the shipping and handling charges, Caring Transitions will be able to charge the credit card on file. If the shipping invoice is not approved and paid within 14 days of being sent, the item(S) will be considered forfeited and no refunds will be issued.
If your listed address is not local then we will assume you will require shipping, unless you schedule a pickup time by emailing
Jconradson@caringtransitions.com
All items must be paid for before they are picked up or shipped.
Caring Transitions Las Vegas reserves the right to hold shipments of fine jewelry, gold, and sterling for up to two weeks before shipment if the buyer's invoice is over $150 and the buyer is not verified with our franchise. In this case, the 30 day period required for shipping invoice payment starts after the two week hold For security reasons, we are currently not able to ship items to a different address than the one associated with your CTBids account. Signature confirmation may be required. We also may require a wire transfer for certain high-end purchases.
Please make sure your address is updated in CTBIDS BEFORE placing a bid. Items will be shipped to the address that appears on your invoice for that auction. If you have not updated your address, Caring Transitions is not liable for items sent to the wrong address.
"}}

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
